stable.notes: The wire's far end as a Cascade: Node, then Connector, then Cavity. The Remote Connector cell is editable and lists the node's connectors (C-number, part number, device) and splices; the Function fill asks which connector when two devices on one node carry it; a splice-only node lands on its splice at once; splices carry a label; junctions leave the Node dropdown. A typed Remote Cavity is saved; status, remote function and wire length follow an edit.

beta.notes: Parts Database fixes reported by OBR: the Save / Discard / Cancel prompt of a new device no longer comes back after every Cancel (nor nests inside Save, nor lets Discard load the first device over the new one); a terminal, housing or other part saved, renamed or deleted under Connector Parts reaches the Connectors tab's dropdowns at once (no restart or Reload needed), a wire saved reaches the Functions tab's Default Wire list, a function saved reaches the Devices tab.
